programme.title: Panda Plan

programme.title: I Want to Be Rich
programme.desc: Born into poverty, Wah goes astray but has a kind heart. After meeting and falling in love with a Vietnamese woman Mei, he decides to rebuild his life and finally achieves his dream of wealth.

programme.title: Hit N Fun
programme.desc: Ad executive Lin uncovers her boyfriend's affair with a champion boxer and challenges her to a match. Under the former boxing legend's training, her quest for revenge evolves into self-discovery.

programme.title: 8 Bucks Tycoon
programme.desc: When a struggling painter receives a magical wallet that endlessly produces RM8 notes, his life transforms from hardship to luxury. However, is this miracle truly a blessing or a hidden curse?

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 1
programme.desc: First instalment of the new remake of The Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber, adapted from Jin Yong's novel, see Zhang Wu Ji embroiled in a dispute involving two legendary weapons.

programme.title: Stand Up Story
programme.desc: Mancer cares for his intellectually challenged father Wah. When Mancer finds solace in stand-up comedy, he turns his life's hardships into comedic gold, from school ridicule to pandemic woes.

programme.title: Detective Dee and Nine-storey Demon Buil
programme.desc: Detective Dee investigates a series of strange incidents at Tang's building, finding the master suspicious when even his eldest daughter secretly tells Dee of his odd behavior.

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: Ip Man fights some gangsters to protect a school, and is challenged by a Wing Chun master. He accepts the duel for his family and disciples and emerges victorious, securing the Grandmaster title.

programme.title: Song of Spring
programme.desc: This is a touching story about an 85-year-old mother caring for her 65-year-old daughter with Alzheimer's disease.

programme.title: Out of Order
programme.desc: A successful lawyer's secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos.

programme.title: Band Four
programme.desc: An aspiring singer reunites with her estranged guitarist father, and along with other family members, they unite to support each other through their love for music.

programme.title: Chilli Laugh Story
programme.desc: Coba turns his mother's chili sauce into a trendy commodity during the pandemic, with the help of the whole family. The business booms online, bringing them unexpected success and unity.

programme.title: Bursting Point
programme.desc: A failed drug raid leaves an undercover cop trapped and a drug lord vowing to seek revenge. Senior Police Inspector Li resorts to blackmailing a drug dealer with his daughter to arrest the drug lord.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 3
programme.desc: Gambling tycoon Man suddenly marries Sophie, who will secure his grandmaster title when he dies. When Man suffers a heart attack, his son must fight Sophie to safeguard the family's gambling business.

programme.title: Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: A family running a Chinese dessert shop faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. This heartfelt journey reveals the strength of family bonds, sacrifices, and resilience.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well 2009
programme.desc: Yu Chu is brilliant but impossible to date. Her brother hires love expert Dick to woo her and break a curse but Yu Chu falls for him fast and won't let Dick go without a fight.

programme.title: Go For Broke
programme.desc: With his family destroyed by drug dealers, Zhang Yao teams up with detective An to take down the drug lords. As the revenge plot unfolds, do they share a common foe or harbour personal agendas?

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: Chow Yun-Fat plays the unlucky gambler Chui Sui-Fai, whose ex-girlfriend asks him to take care of their autistic son. He reluctantly agreed and the two slowly begin to build their relationship.

programme.title: Moscow Mission
programme.desc: A Chinese police officer disguises as a businessman takes charge of an operation to arrest the criminals who perform a heist on the train, but uncovers a bigger conspiracy instead...

programme.title: I Still Remember
programme.desc: An uplifting sports drama focusing on a property agent who leads an aimless, unfulfilling life & his P.E teacher, as they seek to find purpose in their lives.

programme.title: See You Tomorrow
programme.desc: Each city has their own navigators that help solve relationship issues in this chaotic world. Chen & Guan are legendary navigators, but problem arises after they decided to help a girl named Xiao Yu.

programme.title: Born to Fly
programme.desc: Headed by elite pilots, a special operations team is tasked to test new fighter jets. During test flights, the pilots face different difficulties and challenges, and try to push beyond their limits.

programme.title: The Lady Iron Chef
programme.desc: In order to win her future mother-in-law's approval, Ceci must be crowned in a gourmet cooking competition. However, there's a catch; Ceci is terrible at cooking.

programme.title: The Brotherhood of Rebel
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his friend Meow flee after Meow's attempt to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, their paths cross when Meow's life is in danger again. Will Chai choose loyalty over duty?

programme.title: God of Gambler's Return
programme.desc: A Taiwanese crime boss wants to become the new God of Gamblers, so he kills Gao Jin's pregnant wife. Gao Jin is indignant and vows to fight the crime boss to avenge his wife's death.

programme.title: We Girls
programme.desc: Gao is in prison as she steals to buy a cochlear implant for her daughter. She befriends 3 women there and upon release, they stand together to defy fate and support each other in life's challenges.

programme.title: Have a Nice Dream

programme.title: Discover New Taiwan Step by Step
programme.desc: The creative production team goes around Taiwan in search of inspiring stories in the country. Get to know more unique individuals and discover the true spirit of Taiwan.

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: According to this sex comedy, the true power behind China's many warlords were the prostitutes that these men would visit.

programme.title: The Kid With the Golden Arm
programme.desc: Director Chang Cheh reunites the Five Venoms in his second biggest cult hit in the West, featuring Lo Meng's most memorable performance.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Director Lu Chun-ku leads Liu Yung, Liang Yun-hsin and 'Thundering Mantis,' Liang Chia-jen on a madcap quest filled with double crosses and triple plots.

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: A man (Alexander Fu Sheng) must learn several unique martial arts styles and compete in three trials before he can marry his beloved.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung woos a famous courtesan, indulges in some gambling and helps out earthquake victims while incognito in Suzhou.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: One of the most enjoyable musicals to grace the Hong Kong screen, this classic stars the husband-and-wife team of Peter Chen and Betty Loh.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: Regular Joes turn heroes to save their neighbourhood, when a local mobster decides to turn their local gossip spot into a gambling den!

programme.title: The Battle Wizard
programme.desc: The peace-loving prince of the Dali nation turns out to be the target for vengeance because of an old romantic feud.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: The dedicated wife of a man being pressured by a nasty belly dancer uncovers a pit of deceit, double-crosses, murder and blackmail.

programme.title: Finger of Doom
programme.desc: A sword-master turned umbrella-maker goes up against a zombie-maker with a 'finger of doom' in this critically acclaimed film.

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Hui Ying-hung stars in this riveting swordswoman epic, as he embarks on a quest to find a missing martial arts manual.

programme.title: The Lady Professional
programme.desc: Lily Ho stars in this movie as a revenge seeking gun-for-hire who always gets her man in more ways than one!

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Ding, a con woman swindles a diamond ring off a rich man, but when it ends up in another man's hands, she now has to get it back.

programme.title: Heroes of Sung
programme.desc: In this period action film, Meng Hung (Shih Szu) must work with Fan Tien-Fu (Lo Lieh) to protect the royal seals of the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: The Monk, Monkey, Friar Sand and Pig find themselves in a realm where women can only give birth to women unless loved by a man.

programme.title: Godfather of Canton
programme.desc: When Commissioner Liu Ta-hua is arrested by special envoy Cheng for corruption, see how Lin, a coolie is unwittingly fated to play a role in his release.

programme.title: Six Assassins
programme.desc: Ling Yun of 'Hellgate' plays a magician-warrior who unwittingly protects a villain from an ambush, until his wife and friend's deaths open his eyes.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: Set in the Han Dynasty, this drama depicts the legendary beauty Diao Chan, and how she used her charms to help her godfather eradicate corrupt court officials.

programme.title: Judgement of an Assassin
programme.desc: This tale of the 100 Poison Clique's obsessive ambition to destroy all rivals climaxes in a bloody clash involving a mass murderer's trial.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Fans of 'The Little Mermaid' are in for a delightful surprise when they see this spectacular Chinese operatic adaptation, where a carp turns into a fairy.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Sparks fly when a female doctor criticizes a fashion designer's creations, but love follows regardless.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: This heartwarming 1963 musical from Shaw Brothers tells the tale of a beautiful shepherdess, whose own problems drag her into a love triangle.

programme.title: The Black Lizard
programme.desc: Kung-fu takes on a macabre, horrific flair in this stunning story of swordsmen and women struggling to save their true loves and their sanity.

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Ti Lung plays a helpless man who is under the spell of an evil witch doctor in this bone-chilling tale of good versus evil.

programme.title: Five Elements Ninjas
programme.desc: When evil ninjas brutally slaughter students from a noble Chinese kung-fu academy, the one survivor forms a powerful group to avenge his fallen comrades.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: An alluring female fairy seeks love among mortals and finds it in a man who takes care of an orphanage.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The film's curious title refers to two props that signal a happy beginning to what develops into a tragic love story, linking a scholar and a local beauty.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: This new adaptation of the most powerful martial arts form is a cult classic for all fans. Witness breathtaking special effects.

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard

programme.title: The Shaolin Avengers
programme.desc: The story of the Shaolin Temple's betrayal by the White-Browed Hermit and Shaolin hothead Fong Sai-yuk's revenge bid gets retold again.

programme.title: The Delinquent

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: A village boy recruits his friends to help peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll by

programme.title: The Happy Trio

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: A stunning snake goddess in human form seduces a young scholar before a Buddhist monk breaks up their union.

programme.title: The Jade Faced Assassin

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: In this retelling of China's most popular romance, superstar Ivy Ling Po plays a scholar who tries to seduce a servant.

programme.title: Village of Tigers
programme.desc: Shu Pei-pei shines in this production alongside hero Yueh Hua, her stalwart companion, in a battle to rid their town of killers and thieves.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: A love rectangle lies at the heart of this romantic drama with an eve of World War II setting. Starring Kwan Shan, Li Ting.

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: A dying crime lord sends a gang of assassins to steal a special herb that may cure him. However, they become the targets of a couple on a vendetta.

programme.title: Rendezvous With Death
programme.desc: A master swordsman takes on a dangerous mission to guard a treasure chest on its way to Xi An. However, he stumbles upon a conspiracy

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: Families win and lose fortunes overnight while neighbours swindle each other as stock as speculation madness takes over Hong Kong.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: A gifted archer and her team embark on a mission to rescue the Cao King's kidnapped daughter from notorious bandits.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Two ingenious lovebirds come up with what they think is a fool proof plan to get their parents to allow them to wed. Starring Ching Li.

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: When Ko Chien, a downtrodden kung fu student seeks to save the life of a kung fu master and learn new skills, fate labels him a traitor instead.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star

programme.desc: Pengalaman berkurung dengan pasangan selama musim PKP memaksa dua pasangan suami isteri menilai semula perkahwinan mereka yang telah disalah ertikan selama ini.

programme.title: Hingga Jumpa Lagi

programme.desc: Zulkefli and Badariah are always arguing, but in order to prevent the factory where they work from being closed by Qarina, they must work together. Out of hatred, they start feeling for each other.

programme.title: Jihan Nak Displin Anak
programme.desc: Jihan dan suami kalut apabila anak mereka tidak mahu pulang beraya di kampung. Mereka cuba untuk mendisiplinkan anak mereka sebelum hari raya

programme.title: Satu Kampung Dua Orang
programme.desc: Selepas banjir besar melanda, semua penduduk kampung berpindah kerana kampung mereka tidak lagi selamat. Hanya dua beradik yang enggan berpindah atas sebab dan alasan mereka tersendiri.

programme.title: Jamil Balik Kampung
programme.desc: Kisah perjalanan Jamil pulang ke kampung untuk meminang kekasihnya setelah pinangannya pernah ditolak beberapa kali. Berjayakah misi Jamil kali ini?

programme.title: Sampai Nanti
programme.desc: Kyle dan Milly bertemu kembali setelah 10 tahun terpisah dan cinta lama kembali terjalin. Tetapi adakah cinta mereka akan terus kekal hingga ke akhirnya?

programme.title: Tolong Saya Encik Dinosaur

programme.title: Cubit - Cubit Cinta
programme.desc: Kupid Cubit is a dating app that enables the masses to find love. But for Katarina and Saiful, it's a platform for healing people with unrequited love.

programme.title: Duit Kawin
programme.desc: Memaparkan pemikiran remaja sekarang terhadap perkahwinan dari sudut kos atas syariat agama tetapi tertekan cara hidup zaman kini yang mahukan kemewahan.

programme.title: Ayat Dari Langit
programme.desc: Ustaz Muiz dan isterinya mengajar ajaran sesat dan mahu pengikutnya mengikut telunjuk mereka yang lama kelamaan mula membuatkan pengikutnya bernama Kamal mula merasa sangsi.

programme.title: Cinta Round 1

programme.title: Racun Suami Jahanam
programme.desc: Suraya is a naive village girl who looks forward to happy days when Hazrul proposes to her. But those happy days are only temporary when she learns who Hazrul really is.

programme.title: 6 Hari
programme.desc: Suzi is content with being a third wife and living alone in her bungalow as she only entertains her husband every 6 days. Everything comes crashing when a person from her past returns to her life.

programme.title: Diva Dari Jakarta

programme.title: Puyah & Putat

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: we'll be seeing the best penguin fails, p-p-p-party penguins, we'll get up close and personal with wild animals, and we'll go on safari. we'll also meet angry animals living the thug life, some crazy critters, and we'll watch sporty animals in action.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt is asked by a local cat charity to treat a litter of tiny abandoned kittens. They're so weak, it's touch and go whether any of them will survive.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The era of high housing prices shocks the masses. However, some are willing to live in the mountains for their beloved parrots, just to give them the best breeding environment. Parrots have a long lifespan and their IQ is comparable to that of a five-year-old child. How do you make them behave? Training is actually a good way, but how? "Melon seeds" are key to the goal. If you want to raise a parrot, there are in fact many restrictions on choosing the right one. How should I put it? Don’t miss "Cute Pet Guide"!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: At Flamingoland, Oscar the male ostrich has been limping and Dr. Matt is determined to find out why.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In the heart of London, Inspector Callum Isitt teams up with the police to track down four dogs, including two St Bernard types that have allegedly been beaten by their owners. One trail leads Callum to bustling Parliament Square, where it’s believed the St Bernard types are being used to get passers-by to part with their cash. Will he manage to find the dogs that he is looking for?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from "The Avengers"!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt has been called to the Flamingoland aquarium, to set upright some upside-down male seahorses. He diagnoses gas bubble disease, which means a delicate operation to inject drugs directly into the tiny fish's pouch.

programme.title: My House And Other Animals
programme.desc: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Huang Yunong's Yunong Reptile Studio has an extraordinary passion for geckos and he regards every gecko as his own. He always feel sad when consumers buy them, just like saying goodbye to his own child. He always shares care knowledge in great detail, and cultivates concepts through his own experience to let more people know more about hem. He hopes that through "Cute Pets Coming", the overall gecko raising environment can continue to improve.

Flying fails, performing Parrots and the real life angry birds -V we've assembled the very best the web has to offer, guaranteed to make you laugh out loud.

programme.desc: From Christmas as you've never experienced it before, with out-of-tune carol singers, Santa getting stuck, ungrateful children and exploding Christmas puddings - to OAP's, kids and even blundering burglars, six brand spanking new topics are given the trademark LOL treatment, combining user-generated footage with comic narration by comedian Iain Lee. programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: Fishes swim in the water. What a healing thing it would be to be able to look at the blue ocean every day if we can own an underwater world at home! programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt and the keepers at Flamingoland come up with a cunning plan as they face the difficult task of trying to move a three and a half ton white rhino to Sweden. programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc: Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".nnBut they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E04 - Celebration
programme.desc: Otra comida de 5 estrellas de la familia Ewing. Esta vez se trata de una cena para algunos nativos locales. Bradley decide ir a la caza de una cabra para el primer plato de ragú de cabra estofado a fuego lento, seguido de un risotto de pescado, y para el plato principal - cabra al curry con manzana y chutney de escaramujo y para completar la cena una tarta de lava fundida de chocolate de postre.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E05 - Fisherman's Catch
programme.desc: Bradley quiere ofrecer a un grupo de pescadores una cena inusual, algo totalmente inesperado. En el menú: caracoles de mar seguidos de un ambicioso plato de pepinos de mar y como plato principal un risotto de cangrejo Dungeness.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E07 - William And Kate Into The Future
programme.desc: 從普通學生到王室女友，凱特·米德爾頓已轉變為現實中的公主。在不到十年的時間裡，這位出身普通的女孩贏得了她的王子的心，現在正踏上成為英國未來女王的道路。

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E06 - On the Frontline
programme.desc: Desde salvadores de rinocerontes e investigadores de leones, hasta empresarios astutos y equipos de seguridad armados, Iván recorre la primera línea de la conservación para conocer a las personas que están remodelando y protegiendo el África salvaje. ¿Qué significa realmente dedicar la vida a la causa de la conservación? Ivan viaja a cuatro países distintos para averiguar qué mueve a estos héroes anónimos.

programme.title: Dropped - S01:E04 - The Rock Garden
programme.desc: On the third day at 'Prayer Point', Casey gets another chance... but not at the best moment. As Casey answers the call of nature, a bull answers back from the other side of the river, drawn in by the calls coming from the camp.

programme.title: Dropped - S01:E05 - Night Stalkers
programme.desc: 兄弟們感覺很疲憊，繼續沿著下游，已經感到飢餓。他們幾乎無法搭起營地，注意到附近有很多的麋鹿跡象，這裡看起來是一個理想的營地。

programme.title: Wardens - S02:E01 - Operation OHV
programme.desc: 蒙大拿州的遊戲守衛發起了一項行動，以打擊非法的越野車使用。我們還沿著密蘇里河加入了巡邏，以確保水手的安全和遵守規則。

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E05 - Crushed by a Boulder Part 1
programme.desc: Mientras escalaba en solitario el monte Goddard, una remota cima de la Sierra de California, una roca aplasta la pierna de Gregg Hein, que se precipita montaña abajo. Apenas puede detener la caída y se enfrenta a una terrible fractura.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E06 - Crushed by a Boulder Part 2
programme.desc: Después de que su pierna es aplastada por una roca, Gregg Hein queda varado en un alto pico de la Sierra con una fractura compuesta infectada. Sabiendo que no se denunciará su desaparición hasta pasados varios días, Gregg intenta arrastrarse por la montaña y rescatarse a sí mismo.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E06 - Alutiq Anniversary
programme.desc: La familia Ewing organiza una cena para celebrar el 20 aniversario del Museo AlutIq. En el menú: buñuelos de almejas con algas, algas con mermelada de ruibarbo y arándanos, carne de caza con puré de patatas al rábano picante con setas, espárragos y puerros. El reto consiste en elaborar una cena memorable con ingredientes locales para los habitantes de Alutiq y presentarla de una forma que nunca antes hayan probado.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E07 - Bush Pilot's Birthday
programme.desc: El cumpleaños de un piloto de Bush garantiza un menú exquisito con gambas del Pacífico y pasta para empezar el menú de este episodio seguido de pechuga de pato con raíz de apio y como plato principal hay conejo y zanahorias.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E08 - Princess Diana The Uncrowned Queen
programme.desc: 這個節目提供了一個迷人的機會來窺探20世紀最迷人的女性之一的非凡生活，透過美國的視角來看。它包含了拍賣她的裙子的片段。

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E07 - William And Kate Into The Future

programme.desc: Después de que su pierna es aplastada por una roca, Gregg Hein queda varado en un alto pico de la Sierra con una fractura compuesta infectada. Sabiendo que no se denunciará su desaparición hasta pasados varios días, Gregg intenta arrastrarse por la montaña y rescatarse a sí mismo.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E06 - Alutiq Anniversary
programme.desc: La familia Ewing organiza una cena para celebrar el 20 aniversario del Museo AlutIq. En el menú: buñuelos de almejas con algas, algas con mermelada de ruibarbo y arándanos, carne de caza con puré de patatas al rábano picante con setas, espárragos y puerros. El reto consiste en elaborar una cena memorable con ingredientes locales para los habitantes de Alutiq y presentarla de una forma que nunca antes hayan probado.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E07 - Bush Pilot's Birthday
programme.desc: El cumpleaños de un piloto de Bush garantiza un menú exquisito con gambas del Pacífico y pasta para empezar el menú de este episodio seguido de pechuga de pato con raíz de apio y como plato principal hay conejo y zanahorias.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E08 - Princess Diana The Uncrowned Queen
programme.desc: 這個節目提供了一個迷人的機會來窺探20世紀最迷人的女性之一的非凡生活，透過美國的視角來看。它包含了拍賣她的裙子的片段。

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E07 - William And Kate Into The Future
programme.desc: 從普通學生到王室女友，凱特·米德爾頓已轉變為現實中的公主。在不到十年的時間裡，這位出身普通的女孩贏得了她的王子的心，現在正踏上成為英國未來女王的道路。

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E06 - On the Frontline
programme.desc: Desde salvadores de rinocerontes e investigadores de leones, hasta empresarios astutos y equipos de seguridad armados, Iván recorre la primera línea de la conservación para conocer a las personas que están remodelando y protegiendo el África salvaje. ¿Qué significa realmente dedicar la vida a la causa de la conservación? Ivan viaja a cuatro países distintos para averiguar qué mueve a estos héroes anónimos.

programme.title: Dropped - S01:E04 - The Rock Garden
programme.desc: On the third day at 'Prayer Point', Casey gets another chance... but not at the best moment. As Casey answers the call of nature, a bull answers back from the other side of the river, drawn in by the calls coming from the camp.

programme.title: Dropped - S01:E05 - Night Stalkers
programme.desc: 兄弟們感覺很疲憊，繼續沿著下游，已經感到飢餓。他們幾乎無法搭起營地，注意到附近有很多的麋鹿跡象，這裡看起來是一個理想的營地。

programme.title: Wardens - S02:E01 - Operation OHV
programme.desc: 蒙大拿州的遊戲守衛發起了一項行動，以打擊非法的越野車使用。我們還沿著密蘇里河加入了巡邏，以確保水手的安全和遵守規則。

programme.title: Jim Shockey's Uncharted - S01:E07 - Crossroads
programme.desc: Kyrgyzstan Pt2. Corey makes a last ditch attempt to find an Ibex before a satellite phone call changes everything, he must now choose between his family and his best hunting buddy.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S05:E09 - Save a Watermelon Kill a Boar Part 2
programme.desc: Tras matar a un jabalí monstruoso, Manny vuelve al bosque y se enfrenta a un jabalí aún mayor.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S05:E10 - How to Stop a Charging Wild Boar
programme.desc: En este episodio de Savage Wild, nos adentramos en los palmitos con Full Rut Outfitters en busca de jabalíes.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E01 - Alpine Ghosts
programme.desc: Mario takes on the unforgiving alpine mountains of the south island of New Zealand in a fallow deer hunt with his bow, and cooks an impressive venison pie dish.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S01:E02 - Deadly Outback
programme.desc: In the outback of Australia where everything is trying to kill you. It's monsoon season when no one attempts to roam around with salt water crocodiles lurking. Mario links up with a long time friend in search of a wild Buffalo.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S01:E02 - Grizzly Part 1
programme.desc: Laramy sabe que posee las habilidades necesarias para alimentarse, pero ahora quiere cazar al más feroz de todos, un auténtico devorador de hombres: el Grizzly.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S01:E03 - Grizzly: Part 2
programme.desc: Laramy sigue a la caza del Grizzly, también conocido como oso pardo norteamericano. Con un peso medio de 130 a 180 kilos por hembra y de 180 a 360 kilos por macho, el oso pardo es un rival digno.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S01:E04 - Colorado Lion
programme.desc: En Colorado, los leones suelen ser más abundantes en zonas donde abundan los ciervos y los leones individuales se distribuyen en áreas que varían en tamaño de 10 a 370 millas cuadradas. Laramy tendrá mucho trabajo cazándolos.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S01:E05 - Montana Whitetail
programme.desc: Laramy recorre las montañas nevadas de Montana en busca de ciervos de cola blanca.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E03 - Naturally Sustaining
programme.desc: Nuestro viaje en busca de increíbles milagros de la naturaleza comienza en las Islas Canarias. Lanzarote es de origen volcánico. La actividad volcánica creó un paisaje fantástico, similar al de Marte. En Gran Canarias seremos testigos de una cosecha tradicional de un cultivo que desde aquí se ha llevado al resto del mundo: la caña de azúcar. Terminaremos este episodio en la provincia marroquí de Gulemin, hogar de una tribu nómada cuyos compañeros inseparables son los camellos.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E04 - Naturally Colourful
programme.desc: Adéntrese en el estado costero mexicano de Veracruz, al suroeste del país, y admire los increíbles colores de las orquídeas cultivadas en la zona. Descubra cómo se cultiva la vainilla y cómo se elabora el azúcar moreno. Como colofón, asista a un extraordinario ritual. Más tarde, visitaremos las Islas Caimán, en el Caribe. Las tres islas son relativamente pequeñas, pero están habitadas por algunos animales extraordinarios, como tortugas marinas, simpáticas rayas y otros tipos de peces, así como fascinantes iguanas azules.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E05 - Naturally Enigmatic
programme.desc: Hoy visitaremos tres extraordinarios rincones de Europa en busca de los milagros de la naturaleza. Para empezar, nos adentraremos en la región austriaca de Salzburgo. Una zona famosa por sus Alpes y las montañas de Tauern, pero también por ser el lugar de nacimiento de Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. Después, nos trasladaremos al extremo suroccidental del viejo continente, a la región portuguesa del Algarve. Para terminar, admiraremos Córcega, la isla francesa de la belleza.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E06 - Naturally Miraculous
programme.desc: En las selvas tropicales de las Seychelles encontramos una fauna y flora extraordinarias. Después, a Mauricio. Donde el símbolo de la cruel y desconsiderada colonización de África es el extinto pájaro Dodo. Concluimos el episodio de hoy en el corazón mismo de África, en el único lugar del planeta donde viven gorilas de montaña, parientes cercanos de los humanos. El país es la República Democrática del Congo y la provincia que visitaremos es Kivu del Sur.

programme.title: Jim Shockey's Uncharted - S01:E01 - Beginnings
programme.desc: Papua New Guinea. Meet Jim Shockey and Corey Knowlton, two contrasting characters who nevertheless share the same passion to explore and hunt the most remote and uncharted areas on planet earth. First stop: Papua New Guinea

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E01 - Best Moments Part 1
programme.desc: 兄弟克里斯和凱西·基弗回顧了《Dropped》前兩季的一些最佳時刻。他們討論了自己最難忘的單獨狩獵經歷，以及節目隨著時間的推移而發生的變化。

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E02 - Best Moments Part 2
programme.desc: 兄弟克里斯和凱西·基弗回顧了《Dropped》前兩季的一些最佳時刻。他們談論了沒有人見過的幕後花絮，並提前透露了第三季的內容。

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E03 - Dropped And Dragging
programme.desc: 克里斯和凱西·基弗（Chris and Casey Keefer）兩兄弟在阿拉斯加的荒野中開始了另一場冒險。他們正在探索一個十多年來未被獵殺的河流系統，因為那裡的掠食者。旅程開始得很慢，兄弟倆花了更多時間拖著裝備，而不是漂流在河上，周圍是一片充滿灰熊的地方。

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E01 - Into the High Lonesome

programme.desc: Papua New Guinea Pt2. Jim brings meat to the local village while Corey explores leech infested swamps looking for the local deer. Local villagers tell Jim of a remote area 400 miles away where buffalo roam.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E04 - Death In The Water
programme.desc: 尋找成熟的駝鹿開始時，兄弟克里斯和凱西·基弗沿著河流向下移動，但當他們與一隻巨大的母灰熊相遇時，他們得到的遠超過他們的預期。

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E05 - Rising Waters
programme.desc: Chris y Casey Keefer siguen avanzando río abajo, y a medida que se acerca la época de apareamiento de los alces, deben confiar más en pescar, cazar patos y recolectar bayas. Una enorme tormenta de lluvia de Alaska golpea, trayendo grandes desafíos para su éxito.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E06 - All Eyes On Us
programme.desc: Chris and Casey Keefer are back at it, catching fish for dinner and getting closer to being able to leave. But things get tense when a grizzly bear wanders too close to their campsite, putting both brothers in danger!

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E04 - White Death
programme.desc: La nieve, lo que los montañeses llamaban la muerte blanca, detiene a Laramy en su camino. Además, su fiel caballo 7 ha sufrido una herida en una pata. Laramy debe cuidar de Siete, luchar contra el hambre y sobrevivir a la nevada.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E05 - The Struggle
programme.desc: Laramy sigue atrapado en el Campamento Hell Hole, cuidando de la pierna de 7, y luchando por sobrevivir a las gélidas temperaturas sin comida.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E06 - On the Move
programme.desc: Laramy y Siete abandonan el campamento Hell Hole y emprenden de nuevo el camino. Se dirigen a una elevación más baja en busca de un lugar más permanente al que llamar hogar.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E04 - Untouched Atolls
programme.desc: Just off the coast of Africa is a strip of 115 islands called the Seychelles. Mario educates his audience as to how to fish for reef species. Out of know where he even attempts to swim with a sailfish.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E05 - Heartbreak Tuna Capetown
programme.desc: Mario ventures deep into the ocean off the coast of Cape Town in order to catch giant yellow fin tuna, but finds him self biting more than he can chew.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E06 - Getting Close to Black Death
programme.desc: In the wilds of northern South Africa, poaching is everywhere, and the wilderness couldn't be more dangerous. Mario wants to be the first person in the region to hunt a Cape buffalo using a bow and arrow.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S05:E04 - Terry's Brave Heart
programme.desc: 特里透過模仿《勇敢的心》中的威廉·華萊士來惹惱拉里。他不僅可以揮舞威廉爵士的劍，還說服拉里為他建造一座投石機。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S05:E05 - Bond-ing with Larry
programme.desc: 誰是有史以來最偉大的國際動作英雄，Terry Schappert？不。Terry和Larry測試了一些詹姆斯·邦德電影和其他偉大動作英雄的場景。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S05:E06 - Across the Great Divided Lonesome Mighty River
programme.desc: 每個人都喜歡偉大的西部片。 除了拉里。 泰瑞讓拉里測試更多經典西部電影的場景。

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E02 - White Gold
programme.desc: Ivan Carter trabaja para salvar a un elefante clave de los cazadores furtivos de marfil cerca del famoso Parque Nacional Kruger de África.

programme.title: My Two Husbands
programme.desc: 布魯克正在管理與她的高中甜心斯特凡和她的富有年長丈夫丹恩的婚姻。與此同時，她和斯特凡正在設計如何獲得一些現金。當丹恩的女兒伊莉莎即將揭露他們的陰謀時，情況變得複雜。布魯克對整個計劃開始產生第二次想法，似乎一場重大的對抗即將來臨。

programme.title: Here Kills the Bride
programme.desc: Inspired by the Highly Acclaimed Thriller - The Perfect Bride – Jessica is shocked to find out that her brother, Carlos, is getting married in a week to Grace, a girl he just met in a strip club, something he would never regularly do. Determined to find out the real reasons behind the marriage, Jessica gets pulled into a whirlwind of events, putting her own life at risk. Is Carlos in trouble? Or is Grace a victim?

programme.title: Meet You in Scotland
programme.desc: A writer is sent to Scotland to collect a literary award for her boss and is quickly mistaken for someone else by a dashing Scottish poet. Now, she'll need to decide if telling the truth is worth possibly losing the man of her dreams.

programme.title: Pocket Dial Murder
programme.desc: 故事跟隨史黛西，她接到丈夫的誤撥電話。在電話的另一頭，她聽到一名女子的死訊。當她丈夫回家時，他說他的手機不見了。

programme.title: Living Next to Danger
programme.desc: 慈善始於家庭，這句話是Roxanne Robinson重新思考的內容，當她的青春女兒失踪時，所有人開始責怪最近搬進她家後院的鄰居，他們看似完美的房子。

programme.title: Rear View Mirror
programme.desc: 一位年輕的母親試圖逃離她控制且虐待的丈夫，在一個理想化、寧靜的海灘小鎮開始新的生活。

programme.title: Home for a Royal Heart
programme.desc: When the seaside town of Shaw Bay is under threat of a redevelopment, realtor Erin will do anything to save it. Cue the handsome Theo, a royal looking for a new property. The catch is, he's hiding the royal part.

programme.title: Snowkissed
programme.desc: 一位不喜愛旅行的記者追逐她夢寐以求的任務，在那裡她很快就成為一位渴望成為導遊的英俊B&B業主的導師。

programme.title: Mystery Island
programme.desc: 艾米莉亞·普里斯特利博士因需要放鬆的假期而前往神秘島，這是一個沉浸式的謀殺謎題主題度假村。遊戲開始時，悲劇發生了：度假村的隱士創始人被謀殺了。

programme.title: The Love Advisor
programme.desc: Abby works as an assistant and writer of the popular podcast run by her former college friend Serena. Journalist comes from NYC to write about podcast and Serena. Abby starts to develop feelings, but Serena already has a plan for herself.

programme.title: A Match for the Prince
